estimates.assumptions: 4 medium eggplants (approx 300 g each raw, total 1200 g); grilled then peeled; edible flesh only after skin removal (approx 960 g total edible); using 2.4 g net carbs and 1.4 g fiber per 100 g raw eggplant scaled to total raw weight, then adjusted proportionally for edible portion
2 large whole eggs (approx 100 g total); raw, fully used; standard values for whole eggs
1 tsp table salt (approx 6 g); no carbohydrates
4 tsp olive oil (approx 18 g total); pure fat, no carbohydrates
